title: POST /api/projects/:id/journal — create journal entry
description: Create a journal entry for a project. Awards +5 points and logs a timeline event.
acceptanceCriteria: POST requires auth and project ownership
Returns 201 with the created journal entry
Awards +5 points with reason 'Journal entry: TITLE'

steps.details: createJournalSchema = z.object({ title: z.string().min(1).max(500), body: z.string().min(1), mood: z.enum(['excited','blocked','steady','win','learning']).optional() }). Create server/src/routes/journal.ts with mergeParams: true. Mount at /api/projects/:id/journal.

1) getOwnedProject. 2) Validate body. 3) Insert journal_entry. 4) Call awardPoints(projectId, 5, 'Journal entry: TITLE', 'journal'). 5) Call logTimelineEvent(projectId, 'journal', { entryId: entry.id, title, mood }). 6) Return 201.
Create journal entry — verify 201, +5 points, timeline event. Try without body — expect 400.
